model:
rachana: 1
sutra: lei-country
version: 1
description: 
match: { kind: lei-country, where: "$.COUNTRY != 'ALL'", priority: 10 }
title: { pill: "GLEIF · Country (computed)", id: "$.COUNTRY", with: "$.NAME" }
strip:
  - { label: "Entities", bind: "$.ENTITIES", fmt: "entities0", emphasis: true }
  - { label: "Groups present", bind: "$.GROUPS_PRESENT" }
  - { label: "Groups headquartered", bind: "nonblank($.GROUPS_HEADQUARTERED, 0)" }
  - { label: "Lapsed", bind: "nonblank($.LAPSED, 0)" }
  - { label: "Late renewals", bind: "nonblank($.LATE_RENEWALS, 0) > 0 ? $.LATE_RENEWALS + ' late: renewal failed' : 'None late'", tone: "status" }
panels:
  - id: entities
    kind: table
    title: "Entities, by name (a click opens one beside)"
    key: "F2"
    code: "ENT"
    rows: "$.ROWS"
    empty: "No entities"
    columns:
      - { label: "Legal name", bind: "@.NAME" }
      - { label: "City", bind: "@.CITY" }
      - { label: "Renewal", bind: "@.LATE" }
      - { label: "LEI", bind: "@.LEI" }
  - id: groups
    kind: table
    title: "Groups present (entities here)"
    key: "F3"
    rows: "$.GROUP_ROWS"
    columns:
      - { label: "Group (ultimate parent LEI)", bind: "link(@.label, 'lei-group')" }
      - { label: "Entities here", bind: "@.value", fmt: "entities0", total: true }
  - id: note
    kind: kv
    title: "The list"
    area: right
    columns:
      - { label: "Entities listed", bind: "'Every entity of the country in the lake (' + $.ENTITIES + ')'" }
      - { label: "Directory", bind: "link('ALL', 'lei-country', 'Every country')" }
  - id: by-form
    kind: hbar
    title: "Entities by legal form"
    key: "F4"
    area: right
    phone: { tier: "glance", from: "fragment", rows: 5 }
    rows: "$.BY_LEGAL_FORM"
    label: "label"
    value: "value"
    fmt: "entities0"
  - id: by-city
    kind: hbar
    title: "Entities by city"
    area: right
    phone: { tier: "glance", from: "fragment", rows: 5 }
    rows: "$.BY_CITY"
    label: "label"
    value: "value"
    fmt: "entities0"
  - id: source
    kind: kv
    title: "Data source and licence"
    area: right
    phone: { tier: "must", from: "fragment" }
    rows: "$.PROVENANCE"
  - id: built
    kind: provenance
    title: "How this view was built"
    phone: { tier: "more", from: "fragment" }
keys: { F9: "raw" }
